profile.headline: Software Developer @ Concept Plus, LLC
profile.summary: A self-motivated, challenge-embracing software developer trying to soak up all I can through the route of experience, education, and wisdom from others...

positions.title: Junior Software Developer
positions.description:
Contractor at WPAFB
Java web developer 
Applications were migrated to aws cloud just before I came aboard 
Maintenance & sustainment is bulk of work...keeping application up and running with latest aws updates, docker, tomcat, oracle, etc. 
Code changed and page additions as well...

positions.title: Materials Manager
positions.description:
- Created and implemented process improvement procedures.
- Daily cycle counts to keep inventory levels under control. 
 -Managed a crew of welders, shipping/receiving, and material handlers.

positions.title: Laser Dept Manager/Lead Programmer
positions.description:
- Laser Programming through Ncell nesting software (training @ Mitsubishi HQ, in Chicago, IL)
- Brake Press Programming through CadmanB software (training @ Cadman in Buffalo, NY)
- Data entry/Inventory management control.
- Infor/Syteline & Made2Manage ERP business software.
- Throughout my tenure with Fecon, I received 5 promotions...working my way from the shop floor and ending in management.

volunteerExperiences.description:
I coached my son’s T-ball team last spring, it was the most stressful thing I‘ve ever experienced...and I loved it.  
I'll be out there again this year, opening day is 4/27     :)
